chunks: Ahmad b. Harun al-Fami narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abdullah b. Ja'far b. Jami' narrated to us from his father from Ibrahim b. Hashim from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr from Ibrahim b. Ziyad al-Karkhi. He said: al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:
On the Day of Resurrection, Allah -- Blessed and Exalted -- will spread His mercy to the extent that even Iblis will hope for His mercy.

key_terms.إبليس: Iblis - Satan, the accursed one who refused to prostrate to Adam and was expelled from divine grace
key_terms.رحمة: Rahma (mercy) - one of the most emphasized divine attributes in Islam, encompassing all creation
key_terms.يوم القيامة: Day of Resurrection - the final day when all creation will be gathered for judgment

ai.seo_question: How vast will Allah's mercy be on the Day of Resurrection according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) offers a powerful statement about the vastness of God's mercy on the Day of Resurrection. The imagery is striking: God's mercy will be so all-encompassing that even Iblis (Satan), the most cursed being in creation, will dare to hope for it. This does not mean Iblis will be forgiven, but rather illustrates the sheer magnitude of divine mercy on that day, giving believers immense hope while also underscoring God's attribute of al-Rahman (the Most Merciful).
